findings.evidence: The NEVER list has only three items. Most per-rule Traps, such as "A second filled button, even for the same job", state the defect without the reason it hurts. The environment-specific Gotchas, such as MUI Skeleton having no ARIA and sx string spacing bypassing the scale, exist only in references/rules/*.md.
findings.fix: Add a reason to each Trap. Lift the two or three highest-impact gotchas into SKILL.md so the agent reads them before the trigger appears: MUI Skeleton has no ARIA, sx string values are literals, Tailwind arbitrary values are literals.

findings.evidence: "No theme in the repo: flag the missing role and stop." On a build task, this halts low-consequence work rigidly and gives no default.
findings.fix: Replace it with a default plus an escape hatch: "No theme in the repo: on a review, fail tokens and name the missing role; on a build, create one :root custom-property block for the new roles, tell the user, and continue."

findings.evidence: All six evals are React or MUI. None exercises dark mode, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind, or a rule decided by an exception in references/rules/*.md, although the description claims all of these.
findings.fix: Add two evals: a Tailwind or Vue component with `dark:` patches and arbitrary values like `bg-[#3b82f6]`, asserting consistency and tokens fail, and a component where a table scrolls inside its own container, asserting responsive passes.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md says a submit "shows the indicator inside it, whatever the wait". references/rules/loading.md says "the indicator inside it (Apple HIG Buttons) may wait about 1 s". On the build path, these two give different code for the same submit.
findings.fix: Make both say the same thing: "A pending submit disables its button at once; the in-button indicator may appear after about 1 s."

findings.evidence: "flag the missing role and stop" leaves the review verdict undefined: the agent cannot tell whether the tokens row should be fail or na when a repo has no theme.
findings.fix: State the verdict: "No theme in the repo: tokens is fail, with evidence naming the literal and the fix 'add a theme role'."

findings.evidence: The recording template makes "[--new-path PATH]" optional. Following an already-relocated row through step 4 to current or stale and then recording without that flag loses the relocation: audit.py track removes an existing new_path whenever the status is not path-moved and no replacement path is supplied. Subsequent upstream checks return to the obsolete source path.
findings.fix: Require --new-path with the existing row value whenever a row already has new_path, including current, stale and unreachable recordings. Clear that mapping only through an explicit, justified source correction.

findings.evidence: "One call per source row" is followed by a source-less recording branch only for "A command or agent". A skill with no registry rows reaches the model probe but produces zero track calls, so its completed review is never recorded.
findings.fix: Add an explicit branch for skills with no external source rows: perform the model-validity pass and record a source-less local review using track --registry docs/audit/upstream-sources.json --artifact NAME --artifact-kind skill --status current --model MODEL. Handle existing local rows through the same branch.

findings.evidence: After the contents request, the procedure handles "A Not Found (HTTP 404)" and otherwise says "Then classify". If upstreams succeeds but the later contents request returns 403 or times out, this branch still leads toward stale/adopt/adapt/ignore without establishing that the effective path exists.
findings.fix: Gate classification on a successful contents response. For authentication, rate-limit or network failures in this checkpoint, apply the authentication check and single retry; if verification still fails, record unreachable and do not relocate or classify unseen changes.

findings.evidence: The current-row assertion checks only "Includes a track command with --status current"; moved-path assertions similarly check the reported status and path without checking the complete recording command. Wrong-registry, wrong-source or missing-SHA commands are not explicitly rejected despite those fields being central to the protocol.
findings.fix: Strengthen recording assertions to verify the explicit --registry path, exact artifact and copied source, and required --new-path/--sha on relocation. For the model-probe case, verify the selected model is used in both the probe and track command.

findings.evidence: Step 8 says "`ours_updated` reads `git log` on those two paths only and ignores `README.md`, `evals/` and `scripts/`". The step 3 table row (line 23) already says "`git log` covers only those two paths, so a README, eval or script commit does not count".
findings.fix: Keep the full explanation in one place, the step 3 table row. Shorten step 8 to: "Judge the artifact with `skill-judge` when its content changed; the commit must touch `SKILL.md` or `references/` (see step 3)."

findings.evidence: "Write one short prompt that should elicit the behavior: the task the rule guards, without the skill loaded." The skill gives no guidance on how to write a prompt that actually provokes the behavior, or how to read an ambiguous output.
findings.fix: Add a short heuristic. Use the rule's own trigger task, phrased as a user would ask it, long enough for the habit to appear (for example a 150-word prose answer for an em dash rule). Count the behavior as present when it appears at least once.

findings.evidence: "still failing: `unreachable`, never relocate". The same "never relocate" appears on line 23 with no reason given. The NEVER items in the procedure tables are not explained, so an agent may treat a repo-level 404 as a moved path.
findings.fix: Add a Gotchas bullet that gives the reason. Example: "Never run a tree search or record `path-moved` on an auth, rate-limit or repo-level error: the tree query fails the same way, and a wrong `new_path` silently redirects every future `upstreams` run."

findings.evidence: The registry-moved-path expected_output gives "track --registry docs/audit/upstream-sources.json --status path-moved --new-path skills/writing". It has no --artifact, --source or --sha, but SKILL.md step 5 requires `path-moved --new-path <candidate> --sha <sha>` and step 7 requires --artifact and --source.
findings.fix: Make the expected track command complete: --artifact writing-clearly-and-concisely --source joshuadavidthomas/agent-skills:writing --status path-moved --new-path skills/writing --sha <sha from the commits query>. Add a sha to the fixture, and add an assertion that the command includes --sha.

findings.evidence: No output eval covers the `invalid entry:` branch, the `no local commit for source material` branch or a `kind: unversioned` source. Every eval prompt uses precise, formal phrasing; none is casual.
findings.fix: Add an eval for the `no local commit` error, where the agent must stop and must not commit to make the row pass. Add an eval for an unversioned blog-post row that expects `current` with no --sha. Rephrase one existing prompt casually, for example "hey is humanizer still up to date?".

findings.evidence: "Only a skill can have source rows; commands and agents have none, so go to step 6". If a skill has zero rows in the registry, step 7 makes "One call per source row", which is zero calls, and the source-less call is only for `--artifact-kind command|agent`. The model probe result for that skill is never recorded.
findings.fix: Add a branch to step 2: "A skill with no rows: run step 6, then record with the source-less `track --artifact NAME --status current --model MODEL` (or say in updates.md that the skill has no registry row and propose one)."

findings.evidence: "`stale: true`: read both versions, decide `adopt`, `adapt` or `ignore` per upstream change". The step does not say which two versions to compare or how to fetch them. The upstreams row has `merge_base` and `source_updated`, but neither is mentioned here.
findings.fix: Spell out how to get the diff. Example: "Diff the upstream path from `merge_base` to `ref`: `gh api 'repos/<o>/<r>/compare/<merge_base>...<ref>' --jq '.files[] | select(.filename | startswith("<path>")) | .patch'`. Classify each hunk."
